lastItems.title: Making open models work for long-horizon agentic workloads
lastItems.summary: Prefix caching helps coding agents stay fast as conversations grow. Prompts, tool calls, and inference routing determine how much work the model can reuse.

lastItems.title: Introducing Tool Retrieval in the Gemini API
lastItems.summary: Give your agents access to hundreds of tools while using fewer tokens with Tool Retrieval, now in preview in the Gemini API.

lastItems.title: Hebbia sees improvements in financial research with GPT-6 Astra
lastItems.summary: Hebbia tested GPT-6 Astra for financial research. Its prerelease evaluations found gains in source coverage, citation relevance, and presentation quality.
